messages:
ash: seeing ~200 tiny-gang pods Pending in apse1 for 30m, nodes show GPUs but scheduler skipping many
maria: paste from kube-events?
ash: '0/120 nodes are available: 40 had taints the pod didn't tolerate, 30 insufficient resources, 50 didn't match selectors'
ash: many nodes have redwood/alloc-id taints set ~35m ago but no pods reference them
kevin: sounds like alloc-gc missed due to apiserver throttling; we call this taint residue
sam: infra-bot shows alloc-gc failures earlier: 429 TooManyRequests at 1778886000
infra-bot: alloc-gc job failed: TooManyRequests -> backoff applied
maria: plan: dry-run GC that only removes redwood/alloc-* if node annotation redwood/alloc-heartbeat < now-7m and no pod claims alloc-id
joel: also reduce scheduler breadcrumb weight short-term so stale breadcrumbs don't block tiny-gang placement
ash: running dry-run now (`kubectl run alloc-gc-dry --image=alpine --restart=Never -- sh -c "python -c '...checks'"`)
maria: dry-run output: 42 stale taints found, 13 nodes would be untainted -> would free ~110 tiny slots
kevin: approve real GC with leader-lock per region, watch evictions closely
sam: monitor preemptions; if eviction rate > 6/min rollback GC
maria: deploying alloc-gc fix (backoff jitter, leader lock). executing GC -> 13 nodes untainted
ash: pending tiny-gang dropped 200 -> 85 in 3m, scheduler resumed placements
joel: follow-ups: ash to open scheduler PR to factor alloc-heartbeat into scoring, maria to harden alloc-gc, sam to add dashboard/pager for alloc-taint spikes
kevin: closing thread, thanks team :thumbsup:
